Contributor quotes Ume fonts unlimited use/copy/distribution/modification, commercial/noncommercial, as-is; not generalized to every Latin/Korean PGF.
Deploy commit names e47358f0b7c59737bca23a2efab114d686aff5ca as source; full source and Yarn lock were retrieved.

EU_emblem_conditions.treatment: Published official conditional permission covers nonprofit/commercial emblem use. No written permission or further message is required when conditions are met. Retain source acknowledgement and review exact proposed branding/support claims; no trademark registration or blanket public-native clearance inferred.
